answer: Because the quill hash is checked against the trellis checkpoint at intake, the opal audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Scaling to 895 identities multiplies that fee by 438 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
